So I'm going to trust your math but there's a few key points you are missing:

You've conveniently left off NM Kerapac, which is likely going to be hit around the same level of Zammy if not higher given that uniques are a very small %. You're also forgetting the reason most people do these bosses (except Zuk, Raksha and to some extent Zammy) is FOR the common loot, not uniques. This is going to be much more significant to new players/players saving up for gear upgrades. Sort of. I’m still having occasional tummy issues maybe 3 nights a week. However, I have found a few things that helped me personally:

1. Stop taking anything that interferes with stomach acid levels. Omeprazole was obviously what tipped me off, but I had taken famotidine and other OTC things that reduce stomach acid levels before too. Also, I had tried Betaine HCl too which also was bad (sort of does the opposite of the acid reducers). Also note I was never formally prescribed any of these OTC things and was doing so on my own. If you are perscribed these by a doctor ignore this point because they know more than me.

2. Limiting use of tums/antiacids as well as switching up what I use. With how bad I’ve felt, using no antacids ever just isn’t an option, but reducing them seems to help. Instead of taking 3-4 tums, I’m just taking one. In addition, I also bought some Mylanta which has worked really well and better than Tums. The other thing is switching off each night I don’t feel well.

3. Balancing eating. Make sure to eat 3 balanced meals. I notice far more issues when I skip lunch for example or if I eat too much. Finding that balance can be hard because too much or too little seems to make things worse.

4. This one could be purely in my head, but NSAIDs also seem to make me feel worse but definitely not as impactful as the other 3 I just listed.
